name: Frostwall Veteran
theme: A seasoned northern shield warrior hardened by years defending frozen passes, using experience, resilience, and disciplined defensive tactics to withstand overwhelming odds.
visualIdentity: Weathered frozen-steel armor, frostscar round shield, veteran iceblade, thick winter cloak, fur trim, reinforced equipment, and restrained ice-blue veteran effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, armor silhouette, shield design, sword design, fur placement, winter cloak, and blue, silver, white, gray, and ice-blue palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.description: Prevent enemies from advancing through key terrain.

starterAbilities.name: Veteran Resolve
starterAbilities.description: Draw on years of experience to endure tremendous pressure.
